description:
12 utility endpoints for AI agents — QR codes, OG images,   
  screenshots, PDF rendering, web scraping, WHOIS, YouTube transcripts, AI

  card or 100+ cryptos) or x402 USDC pay-per-call on Base mainnet at            
  /api/x402/<name>. Default 0.001 USDC per call (LLM endpoints 0.01).
